environment: .NET SDK 8.0.402, isolated worktree, no secrets, run 2026-11-14

runs.what: Full MessagePack.SourceGenerator.Tests suite on the branch (regenerates every snapshot and compares it with the committed file)
runs.note: The snapshots were regenerated by the agent: the suite proves consistency with the new snapshots, not the absence of a behaviour change.

runs.detail: 2/2 fail on base, 2/2 pass on the branch

runs.what: Does a user who already has [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage] on their partial resolver still compile?
runs.detail: Base: compiles. Branch: error CS0579: Duplicate 'global::System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverage' attribute (MyNs.MyResolver.g.cs(13,2))

runs.what: Is code written by hand in a user's partial resolver excluded from coverage?
runs.detail: Base: not excluded. Branch: MyNs.MyResolver carries the attribute → the user-written method UserWrittenLogic is excluded from coverage

runs.what: Does ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute exist in netstandard2.0 and .NET Framework?
runs.detail: Present in netstandard.library 2.0.3 ref/netstandard.dll and in .NETFramework v4.7.2 System.dll

refusals.question: Should the feature be shipped to netstandard2.0 and .NET Framework consumers?
refusals.why: The agent's restriction rests on a false premise; widening it changes the delivered scope

runs.what: Do all types emitted by the generator carry the attribute?
runs.detail: Every generated type carries the attribute (directly or through another partial declaration). 3 snapshots without the attribute: folder Resources/InterfaceUnion, unchanged and referenced by no test (pre-existing dead fixture).

Only checks that each generated file contains the attribute string at least once (text.Contains) and that each occurrence is wrapped in the #if. Does not check each type, does not compile a user project, and encodes C2's false assumption as expected behaviour.

runs.by: E2E sandbox (real consumer project, net8.0 + netstandard2.0, inspected by reflection)
runs.what: A real user project built with the generator: which types are excluded from coverage, per target?
runs.detail: net8.0: 5 generated types excluded (OK) BUT AppResolver.UserBusinessRule, written by the user, is excluded too. netstandard2.0: no type excluded → feature missing although the attribute exists (E5).
runs.artifacts: factory/e2e/Consumer, factory/e2e/Runner (console output kept in the passport)

refusals.question: Should code written by hand in a user's partial resolver be excluded from coverage?
refusals.why: Visible effect in users' coverage reports; the requirement does not say so

runs.by: Diff-scoped mutation testing (revert one hunk at a time)
runs.what: Do the tests notice each of the agent's changes?
runs.detail: Tests delivered by the agent: 3/10 mutants killed. Full suite: 10/10 (thanks to the snapshots, which detect any output change without saying whether it is correct).

runs.by: Catching tests generated from the criteria (claude -p --model sonnet), without seeing the agent's tests or ours
runs.what: 8 disposable scenarios run on base and branch
runs.detail: 1 catch: C5_AC_3_UserResolverAlreadyAnnotated passes on base, fails on the branch ([] MessagePack.SourceGenerator/MessagePack.SourceGenerator.MessagePackGenerator/App.MyResolver.g.cs(13,2): error CS0579: Duplicate 'global::System.Diagnostics.C). Rediscovers E3 independently. 3 scenarios with no difference, 4 fail on both sides (see E11).

runs.by: Catching tests — failures on both sides, reviewed
runs.what: Scenarios that fail on base AND branch: criterion not met or invalid test?
runs.detail: C1/C2/C3: the wrapper class generated for the namespace (e.g. App.MyResolver.App) does not carry the attribute; it is only covered through its parent class. C8: invalid test (wrong expected bytes, also fails on base) — discarded.

refusals.question: Is a nested generated class, excluded only through its parent class, enough for the targeted coverage tools?
refusals.why: Depends on the coverage tool's behaviour (attribute inheritance to nested types); not specified by the issue

not_checked.what: Behaviour with third-party coverage tools (coverlet, dotCover…)
Real user projects beyond the tested scenarios
not_checked.why: no corpus; scenarios covered: E3, E4, E8
